title: Land the CRM customers in bronze

ticket.subject: CRM customers: we only have the first 50
body: Hi! Someone wired the CRM's customer API into bronze last week, but `bronze.api_customers` only has 50 rows and
the CRM says we have a lot more than that.
The API is paginated with `page` and `page_size` (see API.md in the mission folder). Can you make `ingest.py`
load **every** customer into `bronze.api_customers`, one row per customer? The API key is in the Workbench.
Running it twice must not double the table.

acceptance.text: bronze.api_customers holds every customer of the API, once each.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT id) AS ids, min(id) AS first_id, max(id) AS last_id FROM bronze.api_customers
checks.fail: The table does not hold every customer exactly once.

acceptance.text: The last run followed the pagination to the last page, with the API key on every request.

checks.fail: Your last run did not finish cleanly.
The request log does not show a complete, authorized pass over the pages.

hints: The first answer tells you `total_pages`. Loop from page 1 to that number, inclusive.
Collect every page's `data` in one list, then write it once with `bronze.overwrite(...)`: a rerun replaces the table instead of adding to it.
`page_size` can go up to 100: fewer requests, same result.
